meta.title: Web Request: Cache-Aside with Redis & PostgreSQL

views.label: 1. Client Request
views.note: Browser initiates an authenticated HTTP GET request to the API server.

views.label: 2. Redis Cache Lookup
views.note: API checks Redis for cached record; key is absent resulting in a cache miss.

views.label: 3. PostgreSQL Query & Cache Fill
views.note: API queries PostgreSQL source of truth, receives rows, and populates Redis with TTL.

views.label: 4. Client 200 OK Response
views.note: API serializes payload and returns 200 OK to the browser.

cards.title: Request & Cache Inspection
items: Browser triggers HTTP GET for requested entity ID
API performs O(1) key check against Redis in-memory cache
Cache returns nil indicating cache miss condition

cards.title: Primary Store Fallback & Cache Write
items: API falls back to PostgreSQL primary database via indexed query
Result rows retrieved and parsed into domain models
API sets cached value in Redis with 1-hour expiration TTL (SETEX)

cards.title: Response & Cache Warming
items: Client receives 200 OK response with requested JSON payload
Subsequent requests within TTL hit Redis with sub-millisecond latency
Protects PostgreSQL from repeated duplicate query load
